description: This is a PHP source file defining the CompanyStructureService class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods to manage company hierarchy subunits, including retrieval, addition, deletion, and structure normalization.

classes.name: CompanyStructureService
classes.description: A service class to manage company organizational structure, including subunits operations such as retrieval, addition, deletion, and hierarchy management.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of CompanyStructureDao.

methods.name: setCompanyStructureDao
methods.description: Sets the CompanyStructureDao instance for dependency injection.

methods.name: getSubunitById
methods.description: Retrieves a subunit by its ID. Returns a Subunit object or throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: saveSubunit
methods.description: Persists a Subunit object to the database.

methods.name: addSubunit
methods.description: Adds a child subunit to a parent subunit in the hierarchy.

methods.name: deleteSubunit
methods.description: Deletes a given subunit and its children from the hierarchy.

methods.name: setOrganizationName
methods.description: Updates the root node of the company hierarchy with a new organization name.

methods.name: getSubunitTree
methods.description: Retrieves the entire subunit hierarchy, optionally limited by depth.

methods.name: getSubunitArray
methods.description: Returns a normalized array of subunits excluding the root node for external use.

methods.name: getSubunitChainById
methods.description: Builds an array of IDs representing the chain (ancestry) of a specified subunit.
